intentions: Allow creation of new products with basic attributes such as name, category, and initial stock quantity
Support reading (retrieving) product details by product ID or name
Enable updating existing product information including name, category, and stock levels
Provide deletion of products by their unique identifier
Implement a bulk update operation that modifies the stock quantity for multiple products simultaneously
Ensure the bulk update operation is atomic—either all changes succeed or none are applied (transactional behavior)
Maintain data consistency and integrity during all operations, especially in bulk updates
